messages:
cheng: Heads up — after today's merge (PR #4892) we've seen a ~25% tail-latency spike on decode for rtv workloads. perf-runner flagged a CI perf failure earlier.
perf-runner: CI perf job `perf/latency-suite` failed: decode p95 increased from 34ms -> 45ms, throughput -12%. Link: https://ci.internal/perf/1840209876
maria: Can you confirm this is in the decode path (kernel selection) and not just noisy GPU scheduling?
cheng: Quick triage shows it's the decode path + batching: profiler points to more time in the unfused attention kernel vs before. Also extra H2D memcpy activity in KV cache hotpath.
alex: Ran a quick local bench to reproduce. Output: 
```
./bench_decode --model=gpt-small --bs=8 --seq=1024
before: p95=31ms
after (post-merge): p95=43ms
```
cheng: NVProf snippet from the canary machine: 
```
GPU kernel: attn_unfused_kernel  72.3ms
GPU kernel: attn_fused_v2        21.4ms
memcpy H2D 12.1ms
```
cheng: The fused kernel (attn_fused_v2) used to be the fast path for these seq lengths; now selector seems to pick `attn_unfused_kernel` for ~30% of requests.
maria: Which PR touched kernel selection heuristics or batching? I remember PR 4879 modified fused-op rewriter and PR 4911 changed the batcher heuristics.
perf-runner: Bisect hint: perf CI jumps correlate with merge of PR 4879 on main. Canary with PR 4879 reverted shows metrics back to baseline.
alex: I dug into route batching traces — `route_batcher` is splitting requests into 3 subbatches due to the new `max_tokens_per_batch` logic. That increases kernel-launch overhead and forces a fallback kernel in the selector because shapes become non-uniform.
maria: So two effects: (1) batching splits increase kernel overhead, (2) kernel selector picks generic attention for mixed shapes. Both amplify decode p95.
cheng: Reproduced locally by forcing `max_tokens_per_batch=1` for a subset — same regression. Reverting fused-op rewrite (PR 4879) in canary reduces p95 by ~10ms.
perf-runner: Canary report (short): p95 baseline 31ms -> main 43ms; canary-with-revert 32ms. https://ci.internal/perf/1840209876/canary
devops-bot: Rollout paused at 5% canary at 10:02 UTC per `release/2026-03-18`.
maria: Suggestion: revert PR 4879 immediately from main to stop broader rollout, while we patch selector to check seq-length buckets and batch-shape uniformity before picking fused kernels.
alex: I'll open a hotfix PR adding a guard in kernel_selector: only pick `attn_fused_v2` when batch shapes are uniform and seq_len in {512,1024} buckets. Also add a perf regression test that runs mixed-shape batching scenarios in CI.
cheng: Action items: (1) alex open hotfix PR + perf canary, (2) if canary fails, revert 4879 on main, (3) run `git bisect` across commits touching fused-op & batcher if root cause ambiguous.
maria: Also add a short-term mitigation: increase `min_batch_uniformity_ratio` to 0.9 in prod config to avoid splitting into many tiny subbatches.
cheng: We'll coordinate the revert/hotfix in the next 30m. tagging eng-oncall. cc @maria @alex @devops-bot @perf-runner :warning:
